references.text: God's command to build the altar of uncut stones, without using iron tools that would desecrate the stones
Joshua fulfills this command by building an altar of uncut stones on Mount Ebal, as Moses had commanded
Elijah builds an altar of twelve stones representing the tribes of Israel, in keeping with the tradition of using uncut stones
Instructions to offer burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar, also mentioned in Deuteronomy 27:6
The preceding verses provide context for building the altar with stones that have not been shaped by iron tools
